Scale: the square plate is about 450 px wide in the photo. If it is a side plate of about 22 cm, that gives roughly 0.05 cm per px, so a 2 cm fruit cube is about 40 px. That matches the size of the pieces.

Pineapple: I count about 12 pieces. Each is roughly 2.5x1.5x1.5 cm, which is about 5-6 cm³, or about 6 g. That comes to about 70 g.

Watermelon: I count about 14 cubes. Each is roughly 2x2x1.5 cm, which is about 6 cm³, or about 6 g. That comes to about 85 g.
